name: Bale Hawter
source:
[url=/c7441]Rick[/url]'s gun. A specific magical gun, created from the remains of the No-Life King. It has its own will and can even engage in conversation.

[spoiler]"Eat" the souls of every one who is killed by it, and bring them to the No-Life King to resurrect him. It has specific powers, the usage of which requires serving a part of the soul of its contractor. Its final target is to fully cut the contractor's soul, serve it to the No-Life King, and therefore become a step closer to his resurrection.[spoiler]
